name: Free Computer Training
benefit: Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided with a one-year free training course in Computer, Accounting, Web Designing, or Digital Marketing.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman, serving soldier, widow of a serviceman, or their dependent, and must have passed the 12th standard.
